Cajun Fish
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 12, 2009 - 11:11pm

Ingredients




2/3 cup Parmesan cheese
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 pound Ocean Perch
Cajun Quick (spicy - get in the spice area of store)
3 tablespoons mayonnaise
1 onion, grated

Preparation

1 Mix Parmesan cheese, mayonnaise, lemon juice, and onion together. Sprinkle fish with Cajun Quick on both sides; spread the cheese and mayonnaise mixture over fish. Bake, uncovered, at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes.
